title: Hyderabad sweets got 'silver' leaf that was aluminium, police say

slides.head: Hyderabad sweets got 'silver' leaf that was aluminium, police say
What happened
slides.body: Police seized 49 bundles of aluminium leaves, 10 kg of aluminium flakes, coated sugar balls and other materials.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Police said the fake waraq went on Kaju Katli, Kaju Rolls and Cham Cham, and aluminium flakes into zarda and flavoured paan.

slides.head: aluminium leaves seized
slides.body: Genuine edible silver leaf must be 99.9% pure silver under food safety rules.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Police also seized 10 kg of aluminium flakes in cartons.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Whether food safety officials test sweet shops that bought from these units. Ask: How can buyers verify silver leaf before a lab test?

slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
Hyderabad sweets got 'silver' leaf that was aluminium, police say

The Commissioner's Task Force raided four units it says passed aluminium leaves off as edible silver waraq, supplied to sweet makers and bakeries.

Why it matters: Police said the fake waraq went on Kaju Katli, Kaju Rolls and Cham Cham, and aluminium flakes into zarda and flavoured paan.

Source: Telangana Today. Image: Telangana Today
